A NOTE THAT MATTERS

You don’t need to prove your history.

Hymenal appearance cannot establish sexual history. Hymenoplasty does not restore “virginity,” and bleeding cannot be guaranteed.

Your body deserves respect, whatever you decide.

WHO · Hymenal appearance and sexual history, 2018 ↗
Dr Michel Alain Danino · Hymenoplasty ↗

QUESTIONS, WELCOMED

Let’s make things clearer.

Is hymen.ca a medical clinic?+

No. We are an independent information and enquiry resource. We do not perform procedures, diagnose conditions, or confirm that a procedure is right for you.

Does everyone need an intimate procedure?+

No. Normal vulvas vary. Cosmetic surgery is a personal choice, not a requirement to meet a beauty standard. A clinician can help you understand your anatomy and any symptoms.

SOGC · Canadian guideline, 2022 ↗
What should I know about costs?+

Ask for a written quote in Canadian dollars that separates consultation, surgery, anaesthesia, facility charges, follow-up, and any revision costs. Do not assume advertised prices include everything.

Can I explore without sharing my history?+

Yes. You can read every guide and browse provider links without entering information. Contact details are only sent when you submit the consultation form.

AT YOUR OWN PACE

Ready to discuss your options?

Personal questions deserve care and respect. Start a consultation request without sharing intimate history or photographs. The decision to proceed is always yours.
